product_metadata.title: Homz Multipurpose 7.5 Quart Clear Storage Container Tote Bins with Secure Latching Lids for Home or Office Organization, (5 Pack)
features: Multipurpose 7.5-quart capacity totes are ideal for storing clothing items, seasonal holiday decorations and other large items around your home
Set includes 5 plastic bins and 5 plastic lids to help organize playrooms, home offices, closets, and bedrooms
Constructed of durable, clear plastic materials to easily identify the items inside
SECURE LIDS: Equipped with secure latching lids that snap to the base to form a tight seal and keep dust and dirt out while in storage
Bins can be stacked neatly on top of each other when not in use for an efficient storage solution; Dimensions (L x W x H): 16.25 x 7.00 x 6.13 inches
description: Organize your space with help from this set of five 7.5-quart storage containers. These durable plastic bins with lids are ideal for closet and laundry room shelves, office areas, basements, attics, playrooms, classrooms, etc. Great for storing school supplies, paperwork, photos, shoes, personal items and so much more! Clear plastic bins allow contents to be identified quickly. Having recessed lids, these boxes stack on top of one another and save storage space. Latching handles snap the top securely in place and make the box easy to carry.
